usages.explain: Expresses that there is not much time left until the event happens. In terms of time, 「もうすぐ」is longer than 「すぐ」. It is often used in spoken language.

examples.content: 先生はもうすぐ来ます。
examples.transcription: せんせいはもうすぐきます。
examples.mean: The teacher will be here soon.

examples.content: もうすぐお正月ですね。
examples.transcription: もうすぐおしょうがつですね。

examples.content: もうすぐこの空き地に５０階建てのビルが建つそうだ。
examples.transcription: もうすぐここにごぜろかいだてのびるがたつそうだ。
examples.mean: It seems that a 50-story building will soon be built on this vacant lot.

title: もうすぐ => soon; shortly; before long; nearly; almost
